description: Upcoming dated catalysts (unlocks, emission steps, votes, launches) across the Book, soonest first, at most 20. Optional token slug, tokens (several slugs), kind and horizon in days (default 30, max 180). Text is analyst notes; each event also has symbol, kind, estimated (date marked approximate), a plain title with title_source (curated: hand-written for this note; measured: from the measured unlock size; note: cut from the note), and the measured next unlock (pct_circ, pct_supply, tokens, source, as_of; CoinMarketCap) when it falls within a day of the event, else null. Events whose text starts 'Scheduled unlock' come from the measured schedule alone, fill only slots the analyst events leave free, and are counted in scheduled_total.

tokens.description: Several token slugs, e.g. the coins a person follows.

name: tc_calendar
